job.rawJd:
General recruiter and networking profile, not an employer posting.

Target: Director of Experience Strategy, Director of Product Design, Product Strategy Lead, Senior Product Manager for digital experiences, and AI Product or Implementation Lead.

Core work: understand customer and business problems; lead discovery; shape product and experience direction; translate needs into requirements, priorities, prototypes, and roadmaps; guide product-design teams and cross-functional delivery; and use AI where it solves a real workflow problem.

Resume architecture: lead with product strategy, experience leadership, enterprise UX, team growth, and hands-on product delivery across One Block Away, Hedgehox, Kinesso, and Heartbeat. Keep AI as a practical product-building capability. Consolidate earlier account leadership as evidence of client understanding and delivery, not as the target role or industry.

This package must be fit-gated again against each employer's actual job description before application.

positioning.employerNeed: Turn customer and business problems into useful product direction, strong experiences, aligned teams, and working products.

resume.summary: I lead product and experience strategy, with hands-on work in product design and AI implementation. I led enterprise UX and design systems for platforms used by 7,000+ people across 22 brands and grew a product design team from 2 to 30. Today I turn client problems into AI products and working POCs, carrying the work from discovery into delivery. Earlier client leadership keeps me focused on both the business need and the people using the product.
